sources.label: authored-in-recovery
sources.note: the canonical DOP IR types, the closed vocabularies, checkIr / checkIrProvenance, the deterministic serialization, equality and differences, the tests and the README. Authored from the DOP-native draft 0.2 (§7 the canonical IR, §15 accessibility as a compile-time contract) generalised to the structured, plain-data form a frontend-neutral IR needs: the Level-0 IR of that draft holds function-table references, this one holds the expressions themselves. No Vue or React code was consulted or copied and the package has no dependency but the diagnostic contract's types.

notes: The IR is the semantic authority of OBIX (D-44): a frontend's AST is not, and no frontend AST node, directive name or runtime object may appear in it. Source provenance lives in a separate document (ObixIrProvenance), keyed by the ids the IR nodes carry.
The Level-0 IR of @obinexusltd/obix-core-ir / obix-compiler-legacy-* is a different, frozen artifact (D-46); nothing here imports it.
